properties.summary: Illustrative massing: the three approved office buildings traced from the 2019 plan set's site and roof plans and drawn to the roof heights in the approval: Building 1 at 160 ft on 5th and Brannan streets, Building 2 at 185 ft on 5th and Welsh streets and Building 3 at 150 ft on Bryant Street, each with its lower floors to where it steps back. The affordable housing site at 160 Freelon Street, under construction, is outlined. Terraces, mechanical screens and the public park are not drawn.
properties.note: The approved buildings as simple volumes at their roof heights, not the final designs.

georeference.method: Lot corners drawn on each plan (lots 045, 050 and the former 052, now 176 and 177) matched to DataSF parcel vertices by a least-squares similarity.

properties.license: Footprints: traced from a public SF Planning document. Georeference and the affordable housing lot: DataSF parcels (ODC-PDDL).

properties.label: Building 1
properties.source: illustrative: the roof outline traced from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.0640B/ENX (598 Brannan Street), hearing June 6, 2019, PDF p. 116 (roof plan); roof height from the Planning Commission packet, Record No. 2012.0640B/ENX (598 Brannan Street), hearing June 6, 2019, draft Large Project Authorization (PDF p. 9), approved as Motion 20459
properties.note: Building 1, at 5th and Brannan streets: an 11-story office building, 160 ft to the roof (180 ft with the rooftop mechanical screen), with 289,087 sq ft of office and 22,831 sq ft of retail and PDR space. Its upper floors are drawn as the roof outline, down to the ground; their terraces and the mechanical screen are not.

properties.note: The lower floors of Building 1 where they reach beyond its upper floors, up to level 3 (about 31 ft).

Its upper floors are drawn as the roof outline, down to the ground; their terraces and the mechanical screen are not.
